title: FloodConnect M8 trend signal
description: A single station/reading's trend, 3-state per founder ruling 2026-10-05 ('มีสามสถานะ เพิ่มขึ้น เสถียร ลดลง') plus NO_READOUT when no comparable prior tick exists. This is an INPUT-SHAPE document for a value a caller (kb.py's trend field on a reading row) already produces as a bare string -- it names the shape a future structured trend_signal object would take; it does not itself change kb.py's return type in this part.

tk.description: Number of comparable ticks behind this trend (PROP-FLOOD-01, Toledo tier Dr). Present only when value == RISING -- a non-RISING trend never needs this to decide anything today.

prop11.description: PROP-FLOOD-11 (acceleration) is GATED -- registered in Toledo (PR #65 merged 2026-10-06, tier Dr) but NOT IMPLEMENTED in this release (v0.2 target), not computed -- present only when value == RISING, and even then it is always a refusal shape, never a computed number. The shipped RISING ETA is PROP-FLOOD-02 (linear, two windows), carried separately.
